turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hey, good to have you here. How are you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hi, I'm a student in a rented flat. There's mold on the ceiling above the shower.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: That's really common in bathrooms. Do you have a fan or a window in there?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Oh, also, There's a heat wave coming and I'm trying to figure out what to do on my day off.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Listen to all of them first, then comment.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: One option is going to the lake, but it's an hour drive and the beach has no shade.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Another is spending the afternoon at the mall, which is boring but at least air conditioned.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Option three is going to the public pool in the morning before it gets too hot.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: And the last one is staying home with the fan on and catching up on my shows.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: And that's the last one. What do you think?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: The morning pool trip sounds smart, you get to swim and you're home before the worst of the heat. The lake is lovely, but no shade in a heat wave can be rough. The mall is a fine backup if you need to cool off in the afternoon.
